title: SOS cancel docs and minor behavior divergences vs DELETE path
description: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/emergency.py: (1) class docstring (~line 51-59) still says only 'DELETE cancels.' — update for the new POST type=cancel surface (2.04 CHANGED). (2) Ordering divergence: render_post decodes payload BEFORE the idle check, so a malformed POST-cancel to an idle node returns 400 where DELETE-when-idle returns 404 (render_delete checks active first) — observable only in malformed+idle combos; align or document. (3) Cancel bodies without node/ts are accepted (parity with render_delete which accepts arbitrary signed cores; spec 18.4.2 defines cancel within the alert format that includes them) — tighten both paths if strict format compliance is wanted.
